name: SBayesR
model_likelihood: Gaussian summary-statistic likelihood for marginal effects conditional on multiple regression effects, D and LD B
prior: Point-normal finite mixture with prespecified C and gamma and estimated mixing probabilities and marker-effect variance
inference_algorithm: Gibbs sampling with right-hand-side updates and sparse LD operations
estimand: Posterior mean marker effects and SNP-based variance explained
data_input: Marginal GWAS effect estimates, standard errors, per-variant sample sizes and a population-matched LD reference
tunable_settings: Number of mixture components C; variance weights gamma (default 0, 0.01, 0.1, 1); MCMC iterations, burn-in and thinning; LD shrinkage cutoff; variance-prior degrees of freedom and scale parameters
